UGA.note: Nothing on the central bank's role.
Only planned e-commerce redress and a proposed Consumer Protection Act; no rules in force or drafted stated.
Only the AU strategy is named; no Ugandan national strategy stated.

facts.fact: The Daily Monitor says Uganda currently relies on a piecemeal framework including the Electronic Transactions Act.

UGA.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The Daily Monitor says Uganda currently relies on a regulatory framework including the National Payment Systems Act and guidelines issued by financial regulators.

UGA.note: Uganda is said to champion the AU single digital market; no signed agreement, seat or meeting hosted stated.
Nothing on mobile money or retail payment services.
